name: Wall Sit March
steps: Lean against a wall and slide down until your thighs approach horizontal and your knees are above your ankles.
Brace your core tightly and rest your hands lightly against the wall beside your hips or cross your arms over your chest.
Lift one foot smoothly a few inches off the floor while keeping your hips completely level and your opposite foot planted firmly.
Set that foot back down with control and lift the opposite foot, continuing to alternate legs on each repetition.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed against the wall and avoid twisting your hips when lifting each foot.
Raise your hips slightly higher up the wall if holding parallel makes marching unsteady.
